sharedRequirements.SH-01: Current role/tenant/employee policy plus exact issuer-bound reviewed new-hire mapping and start-date gate; actual local new-hire OIDC and privileged MFA browser verification passed
sharedRequirements.SH-02: Current independent talent approval inbox and bounded HR responsibility delegation/recall/history implemented; database/architecture tests passed, latest UI browser verification pending. Delegation does not grant permissions or override self-approval.
sharedRequirements.SH-03: Committed in-app workflow notices with unique event/recipient and current scope recheck passed PostgreSQL and browser tests. Scheduled overdue/reminder jobs remain open; no external email delivery asserted.
sharedRequirements.SH-04: Authorized audited current-page CSV export (up to 10 rows), current scope, safe quoting and drill-down verified. All-filtered batch exports and enterprise reporting suite remain open.
sharedRequirements.SH-05: Atomic actor/time/reason/correlation and before/after history with database retention guards
sharedRequirements.SH-06: Review/course policies plus independently reviewed payroll annual salary/paid-hours basis and explicit approval responsibility windows; enterprise/country policies remain open
sharedRequirements.SH-08: Actual transactional Core HR hire/activation, reviewed new-hire binding, effective payroll salary/bonus consumption and balanced finance draft; legacy intake reconciliation exposed. Production vendor/bank interfaces not connected.
sharedRequirements.SH-09: Explicit planning currency and UTC dates; translations/country policy remain open
sharedRequirements.SH-10: Current access/audit controls. Required business input requested: approved candidate/review/learning/succession retention periods, jurisdictions and legal-hold rules before automatic erasure. No generic financial-history deletion.
